Implemented [GLO-24](https://linear.app/upfrontbeats/issue/GLO-24/add-sentry-to-bff-apollo-server). The BFF’s Apollo Server now reports unexpected execution errors, internal server errors, and upstream unavailability to Sentry. Expected validation and domain errors are excluded, and reported events omit request data and breadcrumbs.

Set `BFF_SENTRY_DSN` for Docker Compose or `SENTRY_DSN` when running the BFF directly. Reporting is disabled when the DSN is unset.

All 23 BFF tests passed on Node.js 22, along with the build, lint, and formatting checks. Live delivery to Sentry was not verified.

input.description:
Add Sentry error reporting to the frame inventory BFF’s Apollo Server.

- Report unexpected GraphQL execution errors, internal server errors, and upstream service unavailability.
- Exclude expected GraphQL validation and domain errors. Remove request data and breadcrumbs from reported events.
- Enable reporting with `BFF_SENTRY_DSN` in Docker Compose or `SENTRY_DSN` when running the BFF directly. Use `SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT` to label events by environment. An unset DSN leaves reporting disabled.

All 23 BFF tests passed on Node.js 22, along with build, lint, and formatting checks. Live delivery to Sentry still needs verification.
